statBlock.name: Banshee
statBlock.description: The ghost of an elf haunts the place she died. She covets beautiful objects and flies into a rage at the sight of her reflection.

sections.Damage resistances: Acid, fire, lightning, and thunder. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained.
sections.Traits:
Detect Life. The banshee can magically sense creatures within 5 miles, except constructs and undead. She knows their general direction only.
Incorporeal Movement. Creatures and objects count as difficult terrain for her movement. She takes 5 (1d10) force damage if she ends her turn inside an object.
Sorrow Bound. She cannot travel more than 5 miles from where she died.
Undead Nature. She needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Corrupting Touch. Melee spell attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 12 (3d6 + 2) necrotic damage.
Horrifying Visage. Each non-undead creature within 60 ft. that can see her makes a DC 13 Wisdom save. Failure leaves it Frightened for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each turn, with disadvantage if she is in its line of sight. Success ends the effect. Once the creature saves or the effect ends, it is immune to this banshee's Horrifying Visage for 24 hours.
Wail (1/day). She can wail only outside sunlight. Each creature within 30 ft. that can hear her makes a DC 13 Constitution save. Failure drops it to 0 HP. Success deals 10 (3d6) psychic damage. Constructs and undead are unaffected.

statBlock.name: Vampire
statBlock.description: A vampire drinks blood and must retreat to its coffin, crypt, or grave by day. It can carry its coffin or enough grave dirt elsewhere to establish another resting place.

sections.Damage resistances: Necrotic. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Traits:
Shapechanger. Outside sunlight and running water, the vampire can use an action to become a Tiny bat, a Medium cloud of mist, or its true form. As a bat, it cannot speak, has a walking speed of 5 ft. and flying speed of 30 ft., and otherwise retains its stats apart from size. Worn gear transforms with it, and carried gear does not. Death returns it to true form. As mist, it cannot use actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It weighs nothing, flies 20 ft. with hover, can stop in hostile creatures' spaces, fits anywhere air can pass without squeezing, and cannot pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saves in mist form and is immune to nonmagical damage other than sunlight damage.
Legendary Resistance (3/day). It can turn a failed save into a success.
Misty Escape. At 0 HP outside its resting place, it becomes mist instead of falling Unconscious. It is destroyed if sunlight or running water prevents the change. At 0 HP in mist form, it cannot revert voluntarily and must reach its resting place in 2 hours or be destroyed. When it arrives, it reverts and is Paralyzed until it has at least 1 HP. An hour spent there at 0 HP restores 1 HP.
Regeneration. It regains 20 HP at the start of each turn if it has at least 1 HP and is outside sunlight and running water. Radiant damage or damage from holy water stops regeneration at the start of its next turn.
Spider Climb. It climbs difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without an ability check.
Undead Nature. It needs no air. A vampire without a formal burial rests beneath a foot of soil at the place where it became undead.
sections.Vampire weaknesses:
Forbiddance. An occupant must invite the vampire before it enters a residence.
Harmed by Running Water. Ending a turn in running water deals 20 acid damage to it.
Stake to the Heart. If a wooden piercing weapon pierces its heart while it is Incapacitated at its resting place, it is Paralyzed until the weapon is removed.
Sunlight Hypersensitivity. Starting its turn in sunlight deals 20 radiant damage to it. It has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks in sunlight.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack (vampire form only). It makes two attacks, with at most one Bite.
Unarmed Strike (vampire form only). Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 8 (1d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage. It can instead Grapple the target on a hit (escape DC 18).
Bite (bat or vampire form only). Melee weapon attack, +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature that is willing, Grappled by this vampire, Incapacitated, or Restrained. Hit 7 (1d6 + 4) piercing plus 10 (3d6) necrotic damage. Reduce the target's maximum HP and heal the vampire by the necrotic damage taken. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a Long Rest, and the target dies if its maximum HP becomes 0. A humanoid killed this way and buried in the ground rises the next night as a Vampire Spawn under its control.
Charm. Choose one humanoid the vampire sees within 30 ft. If the target sees it, the target makes a DC 17 Wisdom save against magic. Failure leaves the target Charmed, treating the vampire as a trusted friend to protect and heed. The target interprets the vampire's actions and requests as favorably as it can and is willing to be bitten. It retains control of its own actions. Each harmful act by the vampire or its allies lets the target repeat the save, ending the effect on success. The charm ends after 24 hours, if the vampire is destroyed, if the two are on different planes, or if the vampire uses a Bonus Action to end it.
Children of the Night (1/day). If the sun is down, it magically calls 2d4 Swarms of Bats or Swarms of Rats. Outdoors it can call 3d6 Wolves instead. The creatures arrive after 1d4 rounds, ally with the vampire, and obey its spoken orders. They stay for 1 hour or until the vampire dies or dismisses them with a Bonus Action.
sections.Legendary actions:
Three legendary actions per round, spent one option at a time after another creature's turn. It regains spent actions at the start of its turn. It cannot use them while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act. If surprised, it can use them only after its first turn.
Move. It moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
Unarmed Strike. It makes one Unarmed Strike.
Bite (2 actions). It makes one Bite attack.
sections.Regional effects: Bats, rats, and wolves grow more numerous around its lair. Within 500 ft., plants wither and grow twisted and thorny, shadows stretch and sometimes move on their own, and fog clings to the ground and occasionally takes strange shapes. The effects end 2d6 days after the vampire is destroyed.

statBlock.name: Nothic
statBlock.description: This one-eyed lurker watches intruders from the dark. It trades secrets pried from other minds for magic items.

sections.Traits: Keen Sight. It has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. It makes two Claw attacks.
Claw. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.
Rotting Gaze. Choose one creature it sees within 30 ft. The creature takes 10 (3d6) necrotic damage if it fails a DC 12 Constitution save against this magic.
Weird Insight. Choose one creature it sees within 30 ft. The creature contests the nothic's Wisdom (Insight) with its Charisma (Deception). If the nothic wins, it magically learns one fact or secret about that creature. A creature immune to Charmed automatically wins the contest.

statBlock.name: Beholder Zombie
statBlock.description: A raised beholder still floats, bites, and fires rays, though it has no control over which ray it uses.

sections.Languages: Understands Deep Speech and Undercommon but cannot speak.
sections.Traits:
Undead Fortitude. If damage drops it to 0 HP, it makes a Constitution save with a DC of 5 plus the damage taken. Skip the save if radiant damage or a critical hit dropped it. A success leaves it at 1 HP.
Undead Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 14 (4d6) piercing damage.
Eye Ray. Choose a target it sees within 60 ft. and roll 1d4 for the ray against that target.
1. Paralyzing Ray. A creature that fails a DC 14 Constitution save is Paralyzed for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on success.
2. Fear Ray. A creature that fails a DC 14 Wisdom save is Frightened for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on success.
3. Enervation Ray. A creature makes a DC 14 Constitution save, taking 36 (8d8) necrotic damage on failure or half on success.
4. Disintegration Ray. A creature that fails a DC 14 Dexterity save takes 45 (10d8) force damage. If this drops it to 0 HP, its body turns to dust. The ray destroys a Large or smaller nonmagical object or creation of magical force outright. For a Huge or larger object of either kind, it disintegrates a 10-ft. cube of it.

statBlock.name: Revenant
statBlock.description: The revenant animates a corpse to hunt a creature that wronged it. Its quest ends when its adversary dies or a year passes, at which point its body crumbles and its soul moves on.

sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Stunned.
sections.Traits:
Regeneration. At the start of each turn it regains 10 HP. Fire or radiant damage stops this healing at the start of its next turn. Its body is destroyed only if it starts its turn at 0 HP and does not regenerate.
Rejuvenation. When its body is destroyed, its soul stays behind. After 24 hours it animates another humanoid corpse on the same plane and returns to full HP. A Wish spell cast before it gains a new body can send it to the afterlife permanently.
Turn Immunity. Effects that turn undead do not affect it.
Vengeful Tracker. It knows the distance and direction to creatures it seeks revenge against, even across planes, and knows when a creature it tracks dies. The revenant hunts multiple adversaries one by one, starting with the creature that killed it.
Undead Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. It makes two Fist attacks.
Fist. Melee weapon attack, +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 11 (2d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage, plus 14 (4d6) bludgeoning damage if the revenant has sworn vengeance against the target. It can instead Grapple a Large or smaller target on a hit (escape DC 14).
Vengeful Glare. Choose one visible creature within 30 ft. against which it has sworn vengeance. On a failed DC 15 Wisdom save, the target is Paralyzed until the revenant damages it or the end of the revenant's next turn. When the paralysis ends, the target is Frightened of the revenant for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each turn to end the fear, with disadvantage if it can see the revenant.

statBlock.name: Poltergeist
statBlock.description: This invisible specter throws furniture and creatures with its mind.

sections.Variant: Uses the Specter base profile with CR 2, Invisibility, and Forceful Slam and Telekinetic Thrust in place of Life Drain.
sections.Damage resistances: Acid, cold, fire, lightning, and thunder. Bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks.
sections.Condition immunities: Charmed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Unconscious.
sections.Languages: Understands all languages it knew in life but cannot speak.
sections.Traits:
Invisibility. It is Invisible.
Incorporeal Movement. Creatures and objects count as difficult terrain for its movement. Ending its turn inside an object deals 5 (1d10) force damage to it.
Sunlight Sensitivity. In sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
Undead Nature. It needs no air, food, drink, or sleep.
sections.Actions:
Forceful Slam. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit 10 (3d6) force damage.
Telekinetic Thrust. Choose one Medium or smaller creature or unattended object of up to 150 lb. within 30 ft. Against a creature, contest the poltergeist's Charisma check with the target's Strength check. If the poltergeist wins, it hurls the creature up to 30 ft. in any direction, including up. If the creature then hits a hard surface or heavy object, it takes 1d6 damage per 10 ft. moved. The text leaves the damage type unspecified. An object nobody is wearing or carrying can be hurled up to 30 ft. in any direction without a check. The poltergeist can use that object to make a ranged attack at +4 against one creature in its path, dealing 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage on a hit.

statBlock.name: Psychic Gray Ooze
statBlock.description: A mature gray ooze can develop enough intelligence to attack another creature's mind.

sections.Variant: Uses the Gray Ooze base profile with Intelligence 6 and the additional Psychic Crush action.
sections.Condition immunities: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Exhaustion, Frightened, Prone.
sections.Senses: Blindsight 60 ft. It is blind beyond that radius. Passive Perception 8.
sections.Traits:
Amorphous. The ooze can pass through a gap as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.
Corrode Metal. After a hit from a nonmagical metal weapon, that weapon permanently loses 1 from its damage rolls. Penalties stack and destroy it at −5. Nonmagical metal ammunition is destroyed after it hits and deals damage. The ooze can eat through 2 inches of nonmagical metal in one round.
False Appearance. A motionless ooze looks like an oily puddle or wet rock.
Ooze Nature. It needs no sleep.
sections.Actions:
Pseudopod. Melee weapon attack, +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning plus 7 (2d6) acid damage. Nonmagical metal armor worn by the target takes a permanent, stacking −1 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor breaks once its AC drops to 10.
Psychic Crush (recharge 5–6). Choose one creature it senses within 60 ft. The creature makes a DC 10 Intelligence save, taking 10 (3d6) psychic damage on failure or half on success.
